I want you to find the Jin'ha facility and discover the source of their weapons technology. We can still turn defeat into victory.|Kenobi and Jinn after finding the wreckage.|<ref name="SW:OW" />}}
A '''''Consular''-class''' [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crashed into the swamps of [[Obredaan]] while two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] were on an investigative [[First mission to Obredaan|mission]].

==Description==
A [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. It was painted [[Color/Legends|red]]<ref name="SW:OW" /> in the livery of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Like other [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of its class, it was 115 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and had three [[Engine/Legends|engine]] units.<ref name="CCS" />

==History==
The Consular cruiser was used by the Jedi Order<ref name="SW:OW" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="Date">The first two chapters of [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']] take place a few [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> to transport two [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]], to [[Obredaan]] to [[First mission to Obredaan|investigate]] the [[Jin'ha]] warriors.<ref name="SW:OW" />

During the mission, the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crashed into the Obredaan swamps and rested in several pieces, while the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were captured. The wreckage was later discovered by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who were sent to [[Second mission to Obredaan|finish]] the original mission.<ref name="SW:OW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Consular''-class cruiser appears in the second chapter of the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']].
